title: Points Reversal on Refunded Transfers and Orders, Paloma Rewards
content:
When a transfer or Mobile Top-Up order that earned Paloma Rewards points is refunded, and the tier's reversal-on-refund term is on, the points it earned are taken back.

## The reversal rule

- **What is reversed.** The points the refunded transfer or order earned. A transfer refunded before delivery never earned any points, so there is nothing to reverse.
- **Exact and once.** A reversal takes back exactly the points of the earning it points to, and does so once; a transfer or order whose earning has already been reversed is not reversed again.
- **Shortfall.** When the points balance is lower than the points to reverse, the balance goes to zero and the shortfall is deducted from the next points earned.
- **Tier.** Reversals of a refunded transfer do not change the tier until the next review.

The reversal appears in the points history against the refunded transfer or order and the earning it takes back.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Points earned on the refunded transfer | Balance before the reversal | Balance after the reversal | Shortfall carried to the next earning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 | 300 | 260 | 0 |
| 40 | 25 | 0 | 15 |

In the second row, if the member's next earning is 30 points, 15 of them meet the shortfall and 15 reach the balance.

## Points of judgement

- A transfer that was refunded while still awaiting funds or in transit had not been delivered and earned nothing; no reversal arises.
- A delivered transfer that earned 26 points and is later refunded loses exactly those 26 points, not a recalculated figure.
- A member whose qualifying transfers fall below the tier's threshold because of a refund keeps the tier until the next review.
